label: 解除控制的退伍兵
status: Complete native source quartet and QA; coordinator final review/export/integration pending

rejectedAttempts.reason: Rejected: visually repeats walk-a with screen-right boot lifted forward and screen-left boot planted; not a clearly opposing step. Identity and alpha were intact. No pixel cleanup attempted.

nativeArtPolicy: All selected raw/master pairs are byte-identical. No alpha cleanup, painting, recolor, crop, per-pose scaling, source padding or source pixel modification. QA composites only.
semanticContract: idle/walk-a/carry-or-work/walk-b. Work raises and examines the original broken control collar as release gesture. Catalog availability does not imply authored gameplay use.
sourceAnomalyResolution: Legacy label might suggest a male veteran, but exact source is an elderly woman. Preserve her distinct identity and do not merge with controlled-soldier. Legacy walking cells repeat contact; selected new walks advance opposite feet.
palettePolicy: Warm tan elderly woman, gray hair, gold hoop, green scarf, patched gray coat and skirt, brown inner top/cane/boots, open gold collar and dark iron chain/key. No armor, helmet or invented faction markings.

idle.review: Elderly gray-haired woman with warm tan face, gold hoop earring, green scarf, patched gray coat, brown top and gray skirt. Near screen-left hand rests on wood cane; far screen-right hand holds visibly open broken gold control collar with two links and key. Both boots planted.

walk-a.review: Aided first step: screen-right boot advances with raised toe and visible angled sole; screen-left boot remains planted. Cane remains in near hand and leans toward supporting side, while skirt hem and collar arm move with stride.

carry-or-work.review: Meaningful release gesture: both boots brace, near hand supports her on cane, far elbow/shoulder raise open broken collar to head/shoulder level. Eyes and face turn toward collar with relieved smile; chain and key hang below.

walk-b.review: Opposite aided step: screen-left boot advances toward viewer, lifted with broad sole visible; screen-right boot is flat and planted. Cane plants farther left, stays in same hand, broken collar stays right. No mirroring or accessory-only fake motion.
